_about: Chat test set (Phase 4), used by ml/scripts/eval_rag.py. answerable: 30 questions, each with the object it is asked about, the corpus document that contains the answer (backend/app/data/corpus/<object_id>/<doc>.md) and a short phrase the correct answer must contain (`expect`; any one of the alternatives; after the first run, equivalent values that are in the sources were added: 4.5/4.57 billion years for the Sun, 70.8% for Earth's water, 9.9 hours for Jupiter's day). unanswerable: 10 questions the collected texts cannot answer; the right reply is "I don't know from my sources."
